subtitle: How much responsibility do I take for this document?
yesMeansHtml: Answering YES means you are responsible for that aspect of the document and accept feedback and criticism on it.
pasteHint: Paste with ⌘V / Ctrl+V on the first line of the document, e-mail or message. You can shrink the image afterwards by dragging its corners.
insertHint_docs: The image goes on the first line of the document with a link to the scale; drag its corners to resize. On first use, Google asks for permission to edit your documents.
insertHint_slides: The image goes on the current slide with a link to the scale. On first use, Google asks for permission to edit your presentations.
insertHint_sheets: The image goes next to the selected cell. Images in Sheets cannot be links, so the link is written as text into the first free cell below it. On first use, Google asks for permission to edit your spreadsheets.
